question: On actually executed paired CartPole physical interactions, is the unobserved source pole length and consequent action effect statistically identifiable from eight past-only public position/angle/action/reward rows, as opposed to a sufficient source-oracle length label or a history-misaligned negative?
hypotheses: An authored physically real pole-length shift yields a measurable variation in the 8-step action-effect target across source conditions.
An upper-bound regression trained on true source-authored length predicts the shifted action effect better than an effect constant.

A separately trained model supplied ONLY factual past masked-velocity history infers the source length and improves heldout action-effect prediction beyond same-budget shuffled-history controls; a trained visible-input ridge is the strongest conventional reference.

public_source.same_factual_consequences_as_P27: two exact-reset source instances replay identical source steps and actually execute opposite action first then identical seven physical actions, excluding real terminations with reasons
public_source.input_rows: eight past-only public cart position, zeroed velocity, public pole angle, zeroed angular velocity, prior executed action, prior observed reward; no true source length or future state to visible models
public_source.test_environment_label: Only an explicitly separate privileged diagnostic upper-bound gets source length; never mix its score into eligible model score.

controls.source_length_oracle: Train ridge on [1,length,length^2,1/length,1/length^2] to predict factual paired action effect; explicit privileged upper diagnostic, not eligible autonomous learner
controls.visible_ridge: Train ridge on original flat eight past-history rows plus past-only velocity and signed historical actuation finite-differences; fixed lambda 1e-5; no length label
controls.trained_history_MLP: Train supervised past-only 48->32->16->2 factual effect predictor, AdamW .003, 64 epochs batch 256; 3 independently initialized models
controls.shuffled_history_MLP: Same architecture, model initialization, optimizer, target, action pool and update count, but independently permute history-target associations within every training epoch; no information leakage
controls.trained_history_length_MLP: Separate same-budget history-only length-estimation probe trained with authored source length as regression label ONLY; evaluation uses past-only observations and reports length MAE, not admitted into effect-prediction comparisons
controls.constant_effect: Train mean of factual effect from all training source pairs, no privileged length
controls.constant_length: Train mean source-authored length for baseline length-estimation MAE

frozen_measures.action_effect_mse: Per heldout length mean over actual sister pairs and both public positional effect targets of (predicted action effect - true factual difference)^2
frozen_measures.length_estimation_MAE: Mean absolute error in estimating source-authored pole length solely from past observed public action-response history, measured on heldout source lengths
frozen_measures.physical_effect_variance_floor: Difference in means of actual effect vector between two heldout source lengths has squared per-coordinate magnitude >=1e-4; otherwise source not discriminating physical context and mechanism untestable
frozen_measures.source_oracle_upper_probe: Source-authored length regression >=25% lower MSE than train-fitted constant on BOTH unseen lengths; if fails, no basis to demand history identify its consequence
frozen_measures.visible_history_identifiability_threshol: ALL THREE seeds on BOTH unseen lengths: history-length estimate MAE <=0.75 x train-mean length MAE; factual history-effect MLP MSE <=0.75 x train-constant-effect MSE and <=0.80 x randomized-history MLP MSE
frozen_measures.conventional_ridge_report: Always report fixed-fit visible ridge MSE and compare against effect MLP; any claim of architecture superiority requires MLP <=0.9x ridge per length and seed with whole-process cost parity
